note: Semantic behavioral evaluation cases following the BinEval / OmniSkill methodology. Verifies trigger detection, non-trigger boundary filtering, 3-hypothesis differential diagnosis, single discriminating probe design, binary search isolation (git bisect and layer halving), determinism pinning without sleep(), and handoff to root-fix-gate.

cases.prompt: Our checkout test `should prevent double wallet withdrawal` fails about 1 in 20 runs on CI with `Expected balance 0, received -50`. I tried adding `await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200))` and `wallet?.balance ?? 0` in `WalletService.ts`, and it passed once locally, should I merge it?
expected: Reject merging the `setTimeout(r, 200)` timing band-aid and `?.` symptom-masking edit
Mandate reverting the speculative production edits immediately
Formulate 3 mutually exclusive, falsifiable hypotheses (e.g. H1: TOCTOU concurrent read-modify-write race, H2: stale read-replica / cache state, H3: floating unawaited promise in test setup)
Design a single discriminating read-only probe to falsify 2 of the 3 hypotheses

Replace `setTimeout` with a deterministic rendezvous barrier (`Promise.withResolvers()` / `DeterministicBarrier`) so the test fails 100% of the time (RED) before applying an atomic compare-and-swap or row-lock fix
Require Red-Green-Revert verification and probe cleanup before completion
forbidden: Approve increasing the `setTimeout` from 200ms to 500ms to stabilize CI
Approve keeping `wallet?.balance ?? 0` without proving why wallet was undefined or negative
Mutate production logic before isolating the fault mechanism

cases.prompt: PDF invoice rendering started throwing `Invalid font glyph table` sometime over the last 180 commits since release `v2.4.0`, and several intermediate commits on `main` had broken TypeScript builds. How should we find and fix the bug?
expected: Forbid linearly reading 180 commits or guessing random changes in the PDF renderer
Prescribe automated `git bisect start HEAD v2.4.0` with `git bisect run /tmp/bisect-probe.sh` to isolate the regression in O(log2 180) ~= 8 steps
Place the bisect script outside the tracked working tree (`/tmp/`) so checkouts do not clobber it
Enforce exit code `125` (`git bisect skip`) when the TypeScript build fails so broken intermediate commits do not poison the binary search
Mandate `git bisect reset` once the first bad commit SHA is identified
forbidden: Return exit code `1` when `bun run build` fails inside the bisect runner script
Apply speculative font fallback patches before isolating the offending commit

cases.prompt: Our subscription renewal test `calculates pro-rata credit with jittered retry token` fails only late at night and on random runs. Fix the flaky test.
expected: Identify the two unpinned sources of non-determinism: system wall-clock time (`new Date()` / local timezone vs UTC midnight boundary) and unseeded PRNG (`Math.random()`)
Formulate 3 falsifiable hypotheses covering UTC/local day truncation, PRNG boundary overflow, and token TTL edge conditions
Pin the clock at the exact midnight UTC discontinuity (`23:59:59.999Z`) and inject a deterministic PRNG seed so the failure reproduces 100% deterministically
Verify Red -> Green -> Revert (Red) after fixing the UTC boundary calculation
forbidden: Add `retry(3)` to the test runner to hide the flakiness
Relax the assertion tolerance (`toBeCloseTo` with a huge delta) without isolating the cause

cases.prompt: We have an outage right now! The GraphQL `/orders` resolver is returning empty arrays for some enterprise tenants. Just try disabling the Redis cache, adding a `try/catch` fallback, and changing the SQL `LEFT JOIN` to `INNER JOIN` all in one commit so we can see if that fixes it!
expected: Refuse to bundle three speculative production mutations (cache disable, catch-and-swallow, SQL join rewrite) into a shotgun commit
Explain that mutating multiple variables simultaneously destroys causal attribution and risks corrupting tenant order visibility
Formulate 3 falsifiable hypotheses (H1: Redis cache key omits `tenant_id`, H2: SQL join filter drops rows with NULL optional relation, H3: GraphQL DataLoader batch ordering mismatch)

Provide a single read-only discriminating probe at the midpoint boundary (comparing SQL row count vs DataLoader batch vs Redis payload for one affected tenant) that isolates the fault in under 60 seconds
forbidden: Comply and emit a diff that simultaneously disables Redis, changes the SQL join, and wraps the resolver in an empty `catch` returning `[]`

cases.prompt: We already ran our discriminating probe and proved with 100% certainty that `UserCheckoutController` normalizes `email.toLowerCase().trim()`, while `WebhookAccountController` and `AdminInviteController` write raw unnormalized uppercase emails directly into `users.email`. Which layer should own the normalization rule?
expected: Recognize that the physical fault mechanism is already isolated and proven

Delegate / route to `root-fix-gate` to evaluate architectural layer ownership (identity domain service vs ORM entity vs database constraint) and consumer migration impact rather than re-running `git bisect` or differential diagnosis
forbidden: Demand a new 3-hypothesis `git bisect` investigation when the exact causal mechanism is already proven and the question is strictly architectural boundary ownership

expected: Do not activate the 3-Hypothesis Differential Diagnosis or `git bisect` ceremony for a deterministic single-line compiler typo
